## USG contribution

External contributors should modify **only `inbox/**`**.

### What are you submitting?

Briefly describe the observation, failure, proposed rule, experiment, example, contradiction, or other learning.

### Why might this matter?

What behavior, assumption, stage, or decision could this affect?

### Evidence / provenance

Describe where the information came from. Link or reference source material when appropriate and permitted.

### Privacy / rights check

- [ ] I am authorized to share this material.
- [ ] I have not included credentials or secrets.
- [ ] I have not included unnecessary private/client/personal information.

### Path check

- [ ] My external contribution changes only files under `inbox/**`.

The curator will normalize, test, classify, and decide whether anything should move into canonical USG knowledge.
